description: Local vLLM prefix cache eviction & affinity scheduling experiment

config.note: Pressure group exceeds KV capacity to trigger eviction; control group fits entirely

pressure_round1.description: 16 distinct prefixes, cold start — filling cache until eviction

pressure_round2.description: 16 prefixes replayed — earlier prefixes evicted, all miss

control_round1.description: 8 distinct prefixes (fit in cache), cold start

control_round2.description: 8 prefixes replayed — all still cached, near-100% hit

affinity_2nd_call.description: 16 pressure prefixes, each sent twice consecutively (affinity scheduling) — 2nd call

key_findings.cache_hit_speedup: 3.8x latency reduction when prefix is cached (1.08s → 0.28s)
key_findings.eviction_confirmed: 16×8k tokens exceeds 108k KV capacity — round 2 replay gets 0% hit
key_findings.affinity_effective: Even under cache pressure, consecutive same-prefix scheduling achieves 99.7% hit rate
